plain: having no one to speak or vote for them

webster.text: Not represented; having no one to act in one's stead.

example.quote: It is by no means necessary that the state which exercises the power contended for, should continue unrepresented.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
